shared_elements: horizontal band with repeated linear/hatched pattern
schematic animal or serpentine creatures in low relief
curving/scrolled linear motifs at the upper zone
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic low-relief motifs including a disc, a horizontal banded pattern and creature/anthropomorphic forms, and both stack their imagery in roughly horizontal zones up a tall vertical field, which is a generic rather than distinctive correspondence. The decisive difference is subject: A is a single anthropomorphic body whose carvings (disc on chest, belt-like arcs, shoulder scrolls) function as attributes of that body, whereas B is a multi-figure narrative-like frieze of profile animals, a seated figure and an arcaded upper register with no unifying body.
